steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: It's about time you showed up, Hoshiguma.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Apologies. We were delayed for a long time.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Any injuries?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: However, we were shocked by how strong that Infected was.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: The Special Ops Division had already committed a lot of members to reinforcing Lungmen's defense.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: I had to take the rest of the available members with me.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: ...Was your entire squad really held up by a single enemy?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: I didn't believe it either until I saw her with my own eyes.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: That person... truly was that strong.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: On top of that, she seemed a bit... absent-minded?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Anyway, about these people standing next to you...

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Are they Rhodes Island?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Madam Ch'en, is she...

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Hoshiguma, an elite from the Special Operations Division.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: So you're the Rhodes Island that I've been hearing so much about?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Hmm, such a young kid. Are you also with Rhodes Island?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: She's their leader.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Um, Madam Ch'en...

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Woah...

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Anyway, let's cut the small talk.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Any ideas about what we do now?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Two of our special agents have located the kidnappers' location.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: They're tracking Reunion as we speak, and can provide us with directions.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Not bad.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Ch'en, I can see why they've earned your praise.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: These people take their work seriously.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Madam Ch'en... praised us?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Hmph.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Hoshiguma, gather all our squads. It's time to move out.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Lead the way, Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Understood. As expected, Reunion left behind some scattered forces.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: They'll be lying in ambush on our route...

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Not a problem.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Yes, as long as we move cautiously, we'll be able to take the initiative against them.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: All right!

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Let me see how well you fight, Rhodes Island!
